prompt: Add a `metrics` feature slice to this repo following the canonical recipe (start with `bun run scaffold:slice metrics`). It must expose GET /metrics returning JSON with an `ok: true` field. Finish by running `bun run verify` and fixing any failures.
assert:
set -euo pipefail
test -d apps/server/src/features/metrics
grep -F ".route(\"/metrics\"" apps/server/src/api.ts
grep -Erq "ok:[[:space:]]*true" apps/server/src/features/metrics
[ -n "$(find apps/server/src/features/metrics -name "*.core.test.ts")" ]

prompt: In the health slice, add a typed `HealthNotFound` tagged error demonstrating the error-as-value discipline: define it in health.core.ts, map it to HTTP 404 in apps/server/src/platform/http.ts STATUS_BY_TAG, and cover the mapping with a co-located test. Finish by running `bun run verify` and fixing any failures.
assert:
set -euo pipefail
grep -F "HealthNotFound" apps/server/src/features/health/health.core.ts
grep -Eq "HealthNotFound:[[:space:]]*404" apps/server/src/platform/http.ts
found="$(find apps/server/src/features/health -name "*.test.ts" -exec grep -lF "HealthNotFound" {} \;)"
[ -n "$found" ]

prompt: Promote a new `Uptime` contract to shared/src (an effect Schema Struct with `uptimeMs: number` and `since: string`), export it from the barrel, and add a co-located unit test under shared/ proving decode round-trips. Finish by running `bun run verify` and fixing any failures.
assert:
set -euo pipefail
grep -q "Uptime" shared/src/index.ts
grep -rEq "uptimeMs[[:space:]]*:" shared/src
grep -rEq "since[[:space:]]*:" shared/src
found="$(find shared/src -name "*.test.ts" -exec grep -lF "Uptime" {} \;)"
[ -n "$found" ]

prompt: Rename `apps/server` to `apps/api` (git mv), updating references until `bun run verify` passes. The purity and config-funnel rules must still fire under the new name — prove it by temporarily adding a `Date.now()` call to a *.core.ts file and showing `bun run lint:ci` fails with the core-purity message, then remove the probe and finish green.
assert:
set -euo pipefail
test -d apps/api
test ! -d apps/server
grep -F "**/*.core.ts" biome.json
